about: Reviewed exceptions for tools/neutrality-scan.mjs (CHECKLIST X9). Each entry names the files, the text it allows and why. Write the match as the distinctive part of the flagged text, not all of it, so this file does not flag itself. The scan reports an entry that no longer matches anything, so this list stays accurate.

allow.reason: The default subnet, address range and fixed address of the optional reverse proxy's network in compose.yaml (changeable with MVW_PROXY_SUBNET, MVW_PROXY_RANGE and MVW_PROXY_IP), its gateway, and the install guide's example of another subnet: private ranges that Docker's default address pools do not use.
A made-up port: the test checks that a page on another port of the same host cannot make changes.
The example staging copy's port in a documented example configuration file; owners pick their own.
The OpenClaw Gateway's documented default address, offered as the pre-filled value of a connection's URL field (the user can change it); the test uses the same value as a sample setting.

Hermes' documented default backend address (`hermes serve` / `hermes dashboard` listen on port 9119 of the machine they run on), offered as the pre-filled value of a Hermes connection's address field (the user can change it).
